text.p: HealthCare Financial Partners Inc said Wednesday it has completed its purchase of all the limited partnership interests in HealthCare Financial Partners Funding--II LP for $15.5 million.
HealthCare Financial went public less than a year ago, in November 1996 for $12.50 a share. The stock has risen dramatically since then, trading up 3/8 to 21-1/8 in early trading Wednesday.
HealthCare Financial Partners said it was previously the managing general partner of the Funding--II limited partnership through a wholly-owned subsidiary.

As of the acquisition, the Funding--II limited partnership had about $14.75 million in assets, consisting principally of real estate loans and senior debt with warrants to healthcare service companies, and partnership equity of $14.1 million.
